With Komprise Intelligent Data Management, enterprise IT gets global data intelligence, policy-driven data orchestration, fast data mobilization, and governance while data teams get AI-ready data that is easy to query. Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Software Engineer to join our Productivity Team. The ideal candidate will take a technical leadership role in guiding the team, driving best practices, and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver solutions (tools, automation, services) that enhance organizational efficiency and improve customer experience. As a lead Engineer of this team, you will also mentor a team of engineers, provide hands-on technical guidance and support in building solutions that will eventually be an enabler for different business units across Komprise. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
 The tasks are often unstructured and the issues to handle are less defined, requiring fresh perspectives along with creative approaches.  To apply experiences and knowledge in solving problems that are complex in nature and need in-depth investigation and evaluation.  To demonstrate judgment in not only solving the given problems but to identify problems proactively and suggest plausible solutions.  Should be able to design and implement highly performant, scalable systems catering to different internal/external problem statements.  Drive architecture decisions, code quality standards, and engineering best practices.  Work closely with Engineering, Product Managers, Support, Customer Success and other teams to understand needs and translate them into actionable technical requirements.  This individual must work effectively with immediate team members along with required stakeholders involved in the project.  Need to be self-driven and hence limited supervision and direction are provided, as this individual can operate, drive results and set priorities independently.  The ideal candidate will be a proactive contributor and subject matter expert.  To be successful, this individual must demonstrate favorable results through regular leadership and influence.

QUALIFICATIONS:
o 6-8 years of hands-on experience in software development. o BE/MS Computer Science or equivalent o Prior experience working in a productivity, or solutions (tool/services) focused engineering team is plus. Skills: o Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Python) o Experience in architecting, designing and building internal tools, automation, microservices or workflows. o Solid understanding of distributed systems, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms (AWS /Azure) Collaboration: o Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work across the business units in Komprise • Results-Driven: o Proven experience leading projects, mentoring engineers, or playing a tech-lead role. What You will Bring: • Passion for building tools and solutions that simplify life for engineering, support, customer success and customers. • Ability to operate independently while guiding and uplifting the team. • A strong ownership mindset and the drive to make systems, teams, and processes better. Benefits: • Competitive salary • Flexible vacation policy and remote work options • Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling company How to Apply: Submit your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and why you’d be a great fit for this role to: india_careers@komprise.com. Komprise Intelligent Data Management delivers a single platform to easily analyze, migrate, transparently tier and manage the lifecycle of petabytes of file and object data across hybrid environments. With Komprise, enterprise IT gains full visibility across silos to optimize storage, backup, ransomware and cloud costs. With Komprise Intelligent Data Management, enterprise IT gets global data intelligence, policy-driven data orchestration, fast data mobilization, and governance while data teams get AI-ready data that is easy to query. Enterprises use Komprise to discover, classify, curate, tier and migrate file and object data across any storage, cloud or AI environment. Job Summary We are looking for a hands-on Implementation Engineer to own the end-to-end deployment of Komprise solutions at customer sites. You will be the bridge between Sales, Support, and Engineering, translating business requirements into production-ready architectures and ensuring every customer goes live smoothly. This is a high-impact, customer-facing role where you will work directly with enterprise IT teams, design deployment plans, configure complex storage environments, and drive successful onboarding. If you thrive at the intersection of deep infrastructure work and direct customer engagement, and want to shape how a category-defining product reaches the world, this role is for you. Key Responsibilities Deployment & Customer Onboarding • Lead end-to-end implementation of Komprise solutions for enterprise customers, from initial scoping and discovery through go-live and handoff to Support. • Design and architect deployment plans tailored to customer environments spanning NAS, object storage, cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid configurations. • Configure and deploy Komprise Directors, Observers, and Proxies across on-premises and cloud infrastructure. • Conduct pre-deployment discovery sessions to understand customer storage landscapes, data workflows, migration requirements, and compliance needs. Cross-functional Collaboration • Work closely with Sales Engineering and Customer Success during the pre-sales phase to ensure a smooth transition from POC or trial to production deployment. • Capture field insights and relay product feedback to Engineering and Product Management to influence the roadmap and reduce deployment friction. • Partner with the Implementation Specialist (Deployment Lead) on complex or escalated deployments requiring senior technical oversight. Process & Documentation • Develop and maintain implementation playbooks, deployment checklists, and best-practice documentation for repeatable, scalable deployments. • Drive continuous improvement in implementation processes, tooling, and automation to reduce time-to-go-live. • Troubleshoot deployment-related issues involving Linux, networking, NFS/SMB protocols, DNS, Active Directory, and firewall configurations. Required Qualifications • Experience: 5+ years in implementation, professional services, solutions engineering, or customer-facing deployment roles supporting enterprise software or Saa S platforms. • Linux & Networking: Strong hands-on expertise in Linux system administration and networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, VLAN, routing, and firewall rules. • Storage Protocols: Solid working knowledge of NFS and SMB/CIFS protocols and enterprise storage architectures including NAS (Net App, Dell EMC) and object storage (S3-compatible). • Cloud Platforms: Practical experience with cloud storage services on AWS, Azure, and GCP and deploying software across hybrid cloud environments. • Identity & Access: Familiarity with Windows Active Directory, LDAP, Kerberos authentication, and permission models in multi-domain environments. • Scripting: Proficiency in Shell, Python, or Power Shell for automating deployment tasks and building repeatable tooling. • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple concurrent customer implementations, set expectations, and deliver consistently on timelines. • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication in English; comfortable leading technical workshops, whiteboard sessions, and executive status reviews. •

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications • Virtualization: Experience with VMware v Sphere, Hyper-V, or other hyperconverged and virtualization platforms. • Certifications: Cloud or storage certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, or GCP Professional Cloud Architect. • Data Management: Prior experience in data migration at scale, data lifecycle management, or tiered storage optimization. • Tooling: Exposure to ITSM platforms (Service Now, Jira Service Management) and observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, Splunk). How to Apply Submit your resume highlighting your relevant experience to: india_careers@komprise.com. With Komprise, enterprise IT gains full visibility across silos to optimize storage, backup, ransomware and cloud costs.
